name: web-emerald-fintech-wallet-landing-page
title: Emerald wallet landing page moving from white to deep green with fingerprint security
whatItIs: A tall page: a bright green hero with three phones and floating icons, then white sections with dark green feature cards, numbered steps, a dark emerald security section with a glowing fingerprint scanner and labels, tilted testimonial cards, a green CTA panel, and a footer with a large logo.
whatItMeans: Secure, modern and wealthy; deep green feels stable while white sections keep it fresh.
techniques: Transition the page from white to dark emerald to signal a security section.
Present a glowing fingerprint scanner as a security emblem.
Use dark green cards on light backgrounds for features.
Tilt testimonial cards slightly for depth.
Close with a giant logo in the footer.

vocabulary.definition: A page moving from light to dark sections.
A card rotated slightly for depth.
A vertical list of steps in circles.
